name: [UPDATE 1] Hunter Era
desc:
🤩  HUNTER ERA | NEW CODE AT 45,000 Likes 🎉

😁 Hunter Era is currently compatible for PC, Console & Mobile.

Embark on a journey inspired by the thrilling saga of HxH, where you determine your destiny as the greatest hunter or the most feared villain. With a vast arsenal of equipment and various ways to evolve, from unique skills to powerful artifacts, each step shapes your path. Join a dynamic community, forge strategic alliances, and challenge other players in epic battles. Come play Hunter Era and get ready for the hunt of your life! ✨ 

🕹️ Info: 
     • Max Level: 600
     • Press Q to Dash
     • Press F to Block
     • Press CTRL to Run
     • Press G to Nen Mode

⭐Join our community for updates, codes, and more!
